name: Lonely Road
intro_text:
The road behind you has already disappeared into fog.
Only one thing still feels real: the abandoned car waiting beside the shoulder.
If you want answers, you will have to begin there.

roadside.name: Roadside
roadside.description: You stand alone on a silent roadside. A battered car waits under a dead streetlight, its metal body reflecting the last trace of rain.

inside_car.name: Inside The Car
inside_car.description: You are inside the car now. The cabin smells of dust, gasoline, and old leather. The dashboard is cracked, but the steering wheel and front seats are still intact. The glove box hangs slightly ajar.

enter_car.missing_req_message: Something is stopping you from entering the car.
enter_car.already_done_message: You are already inside the car.

open_glove_box.success_message: You pull open the glove box and peer inside. A small brass key rests beside an old registration slip.
open_glove_box.missing_req_message: You need to be inside the car to check the glove box.
open_glove_box.already_done_message: The glove box is already open. The small brass key is still inside.

take_key.success_message: You get the key and put it into your pocket.
take_key.missing_req_message: You do not see any key you can take right now.

start_car.success_message: You insert the key and turn it. The engine sputters, then roars to life.
start_car.missing_req_message: The ignition will not turn. You need to find the key first.
